label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/config.ts uses Number.parseInt(raw, 10) to parse integer environment variables without checking if there are trailing non-digit characters (such as 'h'), causing '12h' to be parsed as 12 without error. Update the int() parsing function in src/config.ts to validate that the string is fully consumed as an integer and throw an error if invalid.
